title: The WPC Frequently Bought Together for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting…
description: The WPC Frequently Bought Together for WooCommerce WordPress plugin versions up to and including 8.0.2 contain a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability via the 'variation' parameter. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious scripts that execute when users view the affected pages. The vulnerability is worsened by a nonce used in the AJAX handler that is exposed to unauthenticated users, effectively disabling its protection and allowing the handler to be accessed without login.
